lines.text: A mighty king surrounded a small city, but a poor wise man saved it by his wisdom.
Wisdom is better than weapons of war, but one sinner destroys much good.
Dead flies bring a stench to the shepherd's oil, so a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor.
The Teacher has seen slaves on horseback, and he who digs a pit may fall into it.
Do not curse the king even in your thoughts, for a serpent of the field may carry your words.
